newsitem.title: UK: New low cost pensions may spark price war - paper.
newsitem.headline: New low cost pensions may spark price war - paper.

text.p: A price war is looming in the personal pensions market after Eagle Star, a subsidiary of the B.A.T conglomerate, announced a low cost pension and the industry's first money back guarantee, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.
Customers taking out a pension with Eagle Star Direct, the company's telephone sales arm, will be entitled to a full refund of charges if they switch to a different insurer within two years.
The move is likely to add to pressure on traditional pension providers to lower charges as competition increases from low-cost groups such as Virgin Direct, the newspaper said.
